title: Smart Analytics, Business Intelligence and Streaming

header.html: 2. Exploring data transformation with Google Cloud (about 18%)

2.3 Discuss how smart analytics, business intelligence tools and streaming analytics can add value: how Looker democratizes access to data; analyzing and visualizing BigQuery data in Looker; why real-time streaming analytics is critical; the Google Cloud products that modernize data pipelines (Pub/Sub, Dataflow, Managed Service for Apache Spark)
the official Google Cloud Digital Leader exam guide

html:
1Business intelligence with Looker

Business intelligence (BI) turns data into reports, dashboards and insight that people use to decide.

Looker idea Meaning
Democratize data Let many people, not only analysts, answer questions themselves (self-service BI)
Semantic layer Business terms and metrics are defined once so everyone uses the same numbers
Works with BigQuery Live, governed access to the warehouse: real-time reports and dashboards
Embedding and workflows Put insights inside apps and business processes, not just a report

Exam tip

. Looker = self-service BI and a single source of truth for metrics. BigQuery stores and queries; Looker shows and shares.

2Streaming analytics

Streaming analytics analyzes data as it arrives, not hours later.

Batch Streaming
Process stored data in groups, on a schedule Process each event within seconds
Good for monthly reports Good for fraud alerts, live inventory, personalization, monitoring

Why it matters: modern businesses must react now: stop a fraudulent payment, reroute a delivery, adjust a price, personalize a page.

3Products for data pipelines

Product What it does Think of it as
Pub/Sub Messaging service that ingests and delivers events between systems at scale The front door for streaming data
Dataflow Managed, serverless service for stream and batch processing (Apache Beam) The transformer between source and destination
Managed Service for Apache Spark Runs Apache Spark and Hadoop jobs without hand-built clusters (the product earlier named Dataproc) [Verify live] Move existing Spark and Hadoop workloads
BigQuery Warehouse that also ingests streaming data The destination for analysis

A typical streaming pipeline: sources → Pub/Sub → Dataflow → BigQuery → Looker.

Exam tip

. Pub/Sub carries the events, Dataflow processes them, BigQuery stores them, Looker shows them. Existing Spark or Hadoop jobs → Managed Service for Apache Spark.

4Putting it together

Need Answer
Business users want live dashboards on the warehouse Looker on BigQuery
Ingest millions of events a second Pub/Sub
Clean and enrich events in motion Dataflow
Run an existing Spark job in the cloud Managed Service for Apache Spark
Exam tip

. Real-time words in a question (within seconds, as it happens, live) point to streaming: Pub/Sub plus Dataflow. Self-service words point to Looker.

5Exam Q&A

5.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1A company wants business users to build their own reports from governed data without asking analysts. Which product fits best?

  • APub/Sub, a messaging service for events
  • BLooker, a self-service business intelligence platform
  • CBigtable, a low-latency NoSQL database
  • DCloud Storage, an object store for files
Show the answer

Answer: B. Looker democratizes access to data through self-service business intelligence.

S2A retailer wants dashboards that always use the same definition of revenue. Which Looker feature supports this?

  • AStreaming ingestion of every event
  • BA semantic layer that defines metrics once
  • CCold storage of old reports
  • DA load balancer for web traffic
Show the answer

Answer: B. A semantic layer defines business metrics once so every report uses the same numbers.

S3A payment company must detect fraud within seconds of each transaction. Which approach fits?

  • AA monthly batch report on the data warehouse tables
  • BA yearly audit of stored files
  • CA quarterly review of archived backups
  • DReal-time streaming analytics on each event
Show the answer

Answer: D. Streaming analytics processes events as they arrive, which fraud detection needs.

S4Which product ingests and delivers millions of events per second between systems?

  • APub/Sub, a messaging service for events
  • BLooker, which visualizes the data
  • CCloud SQL, a managed relational database
  • DFirestore, a document database for apps
Show the answer

Answer: A. Pub/Sub is the managed messaging service that ingests and delivers events at scale.

S5Which serverless service transforms data in motion, in both streaming and batch jobs?

  • ACloud Storage, which stores objects and backup files
  • BSpanner, which stores global transactions
  • CDataflow, a managed stream and batch processor
  • DLooker, which builds dashboards
Show the answer

Answer: C. Dataflow is the managed service for stream and batch data processing.

S6A company already has Apache Spark jobs and wants to run them in Google Cloud without managing clusters by hand. Which product fits?

  • ACloud Run functions
  • BManaged Service for Apache Spark
  • CCloud Armor
  • DApigee
Show the answer

Answer: B. Managed Service for Apache Spark runs existing Spark and Hadoop workloads as a managed service.

5.2 Recall questions

R1What does Looker democratize?

Show the answer

Access to data, through self-service business intelligence.

R2What is Pub/Sub?

Show the answer

A messaging service for events.

R3What does Dataflow do?

Show the answer

Processes data streams and batches.

R4Which product runs existing Spark jobs?

Show the answer

Managed Service for Apache Spark.

R5What is streaming analytics?

Show the answer

Analyzing data as it arrives.

R6Name the streaming pipeline order.

Show the answer

Pub/Sub, Dataflow, BigQuery, Looker.

6Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Looker self-service BI, semantic layer, works on BigQuery
Streaming react in seconds: fraud, inventory, personalization
Pipeline sources, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, BigQuery, Looker
Spark Managed Service for Apache Spark for existing jobs
